faq.title: Helpful answers before you board.
faq.description: Learn about booking, arrival times, payments, and group travel.
faq.q1: How do I book a ticket?
faq.a1: Search for a trip, choose a scheduled departure, select a seat, enter passenger details, and confirm the booking. You must sign in before booking.
faq.q2: Can I cancel a booking online?
faq.a2: Online cancellations are not currently available. Please contact an Awash Bus office for assistance.
faq.a3: Payment is currently handled at the ticketing office. Additional digital payment options are planned.
faq.a4: Please arrive at least 30 minutes before the scheduled departure time.
faq.q5: Can I book for multiple passengers?
faq.a5: Yes. You can reserve up to six seats in one booking and provide details for each passenger.
